# Design Arena

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://docs.designarena.ai/introduction.md): Programmatic access to the Design Arena leaderboard data
- [Quickstart](https://docs.designarena.ai/quickstart.md): Get API access and fetch live leaderboard data
- [API Overview](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/overview.md): Authentication, endpoints, and rate limits
- [List Arenas](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/arenas.md): Discover available arena types and categories
- [List All Models](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/models.md): Get all models with rankings and tournament placement data across every arena and category
- [Get Leaderboard](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/leaderboard.md): Get current leaderboard rankings for a specific arena and category
